name: Seated Hip Abduction Machine
grip: Hands gripping side support handles beside seat.
description: Push the knees outward against padded machine levers while seated, isolating the gluteus medius and outer hip stabilizers.
setup: Select the desired weight stack load and adjust the swing arms so the lever pads rest against the outer sides of your knees with legs closed.
Sit firmly with your back and hips flat against the backrest, feet placed on the foot supports.
Grasp the side stability handles for support.
instructions: Push your knees outward away from each other against the padded levers into wide hip abduction.
Hold the peak contraction at the widest point for a count of one, feeling the squeeze in your side glutes.
Return slowly under control back to the center position without allowing the weight plates to crash.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
cues: Control the return to the center.
commonMistakes: Leaning or sliding forward on the seat to change the leverage angle.
Using jerky explosive momentum instead of controlled glute contraction.
Allowing the stack to slam between reps.
